spots.text: The engineer's log, last page: Wound it. It does not need winding. Wound it anyway. It is something to do down here.

secrets.name: The Engine Under the Dial
secrets.text: Behind the clock in the north aisle a stair goes down, and under the turning floor is what turns it: a ring of teeth as wide as the room, three pinions, a flywheel, and no one minding any of it.

meta.label: The Clockwork Nave
meta.blurb: The walls are gears and the floor is a clock, and the floor is going round. Stand still on it long enough and you will have been everywhere in the room without taking a step.
